criteria.title: PascalCase routine, function and procedure names
criteria.note: Checks declared PHP/JS routines and SQL CREATE FUNCTION/PROCEDURE. Dynamic names and language-required overrides need review.

criteria.title: camelCase properties and fields
criteria.note: Checks declared PHP properties, JS object/class fields and this-field assignments. Accepts the supplied temp_Value example.

criteria.title: Boolean names contain “is”
criteria.note: Checks boolean literals, PHP bool declarations and recognizable comparison assignments. Confirm dynamically inferred booleans.

criteria.title: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants
criteria.note: Checks PHP const/define and JS const bindings, excluding function bindings. Word boundaries cannot be inferred from all-capital names.

criteria.title: Opening program comment
criteria.note: Requires filename, purpose, developer, date and recent-update summary in the opening comment. Verify the description is accurate.

criteria.title: No unnecessary comments
criteria.note: Flags empty comments and obvious code duplication. Necessity and accuracy require a reviewer.

criteria.title: Commented new or modified code blocks
criteria.note: Applies only when the selected scan scope is New or Modified. Checks nearby comments for brace blocks; confirm meaningful coverage.

criteria.title: Vertically aligned braces
criteria.note: Checks braces outside strings/comments for separate lines and matching indentation. Object literals also follow this convention.

criteria.title: Logical indentation
criteria.note: Checks the selected indentation unit and curly-block depth. Continuations, markup and SQL layout require human review.

criteria.title: One statement per line
criteria.note: Counts statement terminators outside strings/comments; excludes semicolons in for headers.

criteria.title: Distinct local and global variable names
criteria.note: Checks PHP/JS routine parameters and locals against file-level names. Included files, closures and dynamic scopes require review.

criteria.title: External CSS through LINK; no inline styles
criteria.note: Checks markup style attributes, STYLE blocks and JS style assignments. Review generated markup separately.

criteria.title: Parameterized, environment-independent values
criteria.note: Flags literal endpoints and absolute paths outside configuration files. Review other values and parameter binding for environment independence.

criteria.title: Connection strings separated from processing and output
criteria.note: Flags connection initialization in files that do not appear to be dedicated configuration/connection helpers. Verify architecture and data flow.

criteria.title: Encrypted connection passwords
criteria.note: Flags literal passwords in connection calls, DSNs and connection-related assignments. Confirm external secrets are encrypted; encoding is insufficient.

criteria.title: Multiline change trail before modified code
criteria.note: For Modified scope, requires a multiline change summary, developer and valid date. Verify its placement before every changed section using a diff.

criteria.title: Column names do not repeat the table name
criteria.note: Checks columns in CREATE TABLE declarations against the table name and its simple singular form.

criteria.title: Column names do not encode data types
criteria.note: Flags recognizable datatype prefixes/suffixes. Review ambiguous domain names such as date and number.

criteria.title: GRANT requires SAD approval
criteria.note: Every executable GRANT is a request to verify SAD approval. A source comment does not prove approval.

criteria.title: Uppercase SQL reserved words
criteria.note: Checks a bounded SQL keyword list outside quoted strings/identifiers. Dynamic SQL and procedural bodies need review.

criteria.title: Schema owner for database objects
criteria.note: Checks explicit schema qualification or active schema setting. Qualification alone does not establish ownership; verify the database owner.

criteria.title: QMU database object naming
criteria.note: Manual review: the exact QMU database object naming specification has not been supplied.

criteria.title: SQL spool/log creation and matching filenames
criteria.note: Checks SPOOL, psql output and SQLCMD output directives and static filename stems. Successful file creation must be verified after execution.

criteria.title: QMU SQL script format
criteria.note: Manual review: the exact QMU SQL script template has not been supplied. Header and logging checks are recorded separately.
